user_query: I want to surprise my significant other with a romantic evening. Can you calculate our love compatibility using the Flames Love Calculator API? Also, find a romantic Netflix original series from the top 100 ranked list for us to watch together.

TaskList.description: Gather personal names and other relevant details required for love compatibility calculation.
Calculate love compatibility using the Flames Love Calculator API with the provided names.
Fetch the top 100 ranked Netflix original series.
Select a romantic series from the fetched top 100 list.
